knowledge.purpose: Top-of-page navigation bar: logo, link list, and an optional right-aligned utility cluster. The persistent top chrome of a surface.
useCases: Primary site header on a marketing surface
App shell top bar with main nav links
Logged-in dashboard header with profile CTA
antiPatterns: Side navigation — navbar is horizontal-only; use a layout.container with vertical links instead
Embedding full forms inside the navbar — keep it lean (the built-in showSearch box is the only field that belongs here)
Multiple navbars on the same surface
Authoring `account` in a receipt or pattern — the runner injects the real visitor; a hand-written one is a fake session
knowledge.implementation:
Top-of-page navigation bar with logo, link list, and an optional right-aligned utility cluster (search box, social icons, an optional ghost/text secondary CTA followed by the primary CTA, avatar) plus a second co-brand wordmark — sticky-capable: to keep it at the top while the page scrolls, give the block `style: {position: "sticky", top: "0", zIndex: "var(--pw-z-sticky, var(--pw-z-nav))"}` (the engine places these on the block’s wrapper, the element that can stick; the bar then publishes its height so in-page anchors land below it). One painted frame is right at every width: CSS shows the wide row from 768px and the menu button with its drawer below it. Each link may carry EITHER a flat dropdown submenu (items: [{label, href}]) OR a multi-column mega-panel (megaColumns: [{heading?, items: [{label, href?, icon?, description?}]}] plus an optional trailing feature tile {title, description?, href?, icon?}). The cluster can also lead with a free info-slot (rightInfo: [{label?, value, icon?}]) of small muted non-interactive status text (e.g. weather '24°C London', currency 'USDTRY 27.01'), rendered before search/CTA. The secondary CTA pairs a ghost 'Log In' with a primary 'Get Started'.

Further use cases:
- Sticky navbar that follows on scroll for long pages
- Corporate intranet / portal top bar with search, social icons, and a co-branded second wordmark
- Product/solutions mega-menu: a top-level link opening a wide multi-column panel of grouped destinations plus a highlighted feature tile
- Portal header with a free info-slot showing live status (weather, exchange rate, server time) before the search box

Account control: when the runner injects `account`, the decorative avatar is replaced by the shared account menu (blocks/_shared-account-menu.tsx) — a WAI-ARIA menu button (aria-haspopup/expanded, arrow keys, Escape returns focus, outside press closes) opening a card with name + email, Profile (profileHref), `links`, a divider and Sign out. Signed out it renders a "Sign in" button. Sign in/out are emitted as block:click with payload.action {type: "auth:signIn" | "auth:signOut"}; the runner handles them (inert renders report the click without the action). `avatarName`/`avatarSrc` still work for static mock-ups without an account.

Children: a block that carries the nav-utility trait (control.language-switch, control.theme-toggle) placed as a child of the bar draws inside the band, after the bar's own controls, at every width — place the language switch there, not as a row beside the bar, where it draws as a band of its own under it.

props.name: links
props.type: [{label, href, items?: [{label, href}], megaColumns?: [{heading?, items: [{label, href?, icon?, description?}]}], feature?: {title, description?, href?, icon?}}]

match.description: exact (default): current only on its own address. prefix: also marks the section on every page below it ("/guides" on "/guides/records"); aria-current="page" stays on the exact page.
exact (default): current only on its own address. prefix: also marks the section on every page below it ("/guides" on "/guides/records"); aria-current="page" stays on the exact page.

jsonSchema.description: href of the page being viewed — the top-level link that routes there (or whose dropdown holds it) gets aria-current="page" and an underline. Compared as routes (trailing slash, query and in-page anchor ignored; a #/page hash route is read as /page), the same matcher as app-rail and bottom-bar.
The language of the bar’s words (BCP 47, e.g. "en") when it differs from the page’s, written as the element’s lang so uppercase text follows that language’s case rules.

State key the search query is written to when the visitor presses Enter — a data source filtering on {{state.<key>}} re-queries. The submit also emits a block:click event with payload {action:"search", value}.

label.description: The link's name for a screen reader and its tooltip ("GitHub"). Unset: the icon's name.

props.name: logoTagline
props.description: A short word drawn beside the logo text, smaller and fainter, inside the same link: "PWFabric engine". Write it in the app's language. Unlike secondaryLogoText (a second wordmark at the far right), it reads as part of the brand.

props.name: skipTo
props.description: The id of the page's main content (its main landmark). A "Skip to content" link becomes the first keyboard stop, hidden until it is focused.

props.name: skipLinkLabel
props.description: The skip link's word. Unset: the app's ui.skipToContent. Write it in the app's language.

props.name: drawerLinks
props.description: Destinations listed only in the phone drawer, before links — a documentation site's page tree, which the wide bar leaves to its sidebar. Same shape as links; a link with items is drawn with its pages under it.

props.name: contentMaxWidth
props.description: Keep the bar's contents within this width, centred, while its background and bottom line stay full width — set it to the page's own width so the logo lines up with the content. A number is px; a string is a CSS length ("90rem") or a var(). Unset: the contents span the bar.

props.name: logoHref
props.description: Destination for the logo link; omitted, the logo renders unlinked.

props.name: account
props.type: {state: 'signed-in' | 'signed-out', name?, email?, avatarSrc?, profileHref?, profileLabel?, links?: [{label, href}], signInLabel?, signOutLabel?}

jsonSchema.description: The published app's visitor, INJECTED BY THE RUNNER — do not author it. Signed in: an avatar menu button (name beside it on wide screens) opening profile, links and sign out. Signed out: a "Sign in" button. Actions leave as payload.action {type:"auth:signIn"|"auth:signOut"}. Supersedes avatarName/avatarSrc.

tokens.name: paddingInline
tokens.description: Space left and right of the bar’s contents.

tokens.name: logoLetterSpacing
tokens.description: Letter spacing of the brand’s name.
